title: Global well-posedness and scattering for energy-critical Schrodinger equations with conservative Marcus noise
summary: This work establishes global well-posedness for the three-dimensional defocusing energy-critical nonlinear Schrödinger equation with conservative linear Marcus noise. For arbitrary deterministic energy-space data, we construct a probabilistically strong solution, unique in the critical spacetime class, and prove convergence of finite-activity approximations. The spatial profiles need only be bounded and Lipschitz, while the centered pure-jump Lévy noise is assumed to have finite second moment.
